duplicate_candidate_key.description: More than one air-quality row shares the same site/time candidate key.

duplicate_hourly_observation.description: More than one weather row shares the same hourly observation timestamp.

duplicate_location_id.description: More than one taxi zone row shares the same LocationID.

duplicate_trip_fingerprint.description: More than one row shares the same taxi trip fingerprint in the batch.

incomplete_time_parts.description: Weather row is missing one or more date/time parts or derived timestamp.

invalid_pm25_value.description: PM2.5 measurement is NULL or negative.

missing_location_id.description: Taxi zone lookup row is missing LocationID.

missing_zone_reference.description: Pickup or dropoff LocationID is absent from the taxi zone lookup.

null_observation_timestamp.description: Air-quality row has an unparseable GMT timestamp.

null_or_invalid_trip_times.description: Pickup or dropoff timestamp is missing or dropoff is not after pickup.
